title: 12 Best Natural Wine Bars in Adelaide
description: Discover Adelaide's top natural wine bars for 2026! From CBD hotspots to neighborhood gems, find the best biodynamic and minimal intervention wines, delicious food pairings, and unique atmospheres. Your guide to sustainable sips.

places.name: Leigh Street Wine Room
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask for a staff recommendation from their ever-changing 'by the glass' list; pair with the Kingfish Crudo or handmade pasta.

places.name: Good Gilbert
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A glass of something skin-contact from their blackboard specials; pair with the Fried Chicken Sandwich or a selection of charcuterie.

places.name: Cantina Sociale
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try a flight of their own Cantina Sociale wines; pair with the house-made focaccia and a cheese board.

places.name: Community Wine
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Let the sommelier guide your wine choice, perhaps a biodynamic Riesling; pair with the seasonal vegetable dish or a delicate tartare.

places.name: Bar Peripheral
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A funky orange wine from their rotating list; pair with the Wagyu Sando or the seasonal pickles.

places.name: Pink Moon Saloon
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A skin-contact white or a light-bodied natural red; pair with anything from their charcoal grill, especially the skewers or a grilled protein.

places.name: Sunny's Pizza
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A "Pizza Funghi" with a chilled, light-bodied natural red or a pet-nat.

places.name: Part Time Lover
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A natural Fiano or an Australian skin-contact white; pair with the Hiramasa Kingfish Sashimi or the Karaage Chicken.

places.name: Africola Canteen
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A South African natural Chenin Blanc or a pét-nat; pair with the Peri Peri Chicken Roll or the legendary Chicken Salt Chips.

places.name: Mollymawk
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask the bartender for their latest natural red or an interesting skin-contact white; pair with their Wagyu biltong or spiced nuts.

places.name: East End Cellars
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pick any bottle from the shop that catches your eye (they have hundreds of natural options); enjoy with their Coffin Bay Oysters or a generous cheese platter.

places.name: Press Food & Wine
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A natural Shiraz from a local producer; pair with their famous Grass-Fed Skirt Steak or the market fish.
